MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 140, February 07, 1938 ]
FIXING THE SALARIES OF THE OFFICERS OF THE PHILIPPINE ARMY
Pursuant to the provisions of section ninety of the National Defense Act, I, MANUEL L. QUEZON, President
of the Philippines, do hereby prescribe the following schedule of salary rates for officers of the Philippine
Army, effective February first, nineteen hundred and thirty-eight:
Major General—Chief of Staff
Major Generals
7,800.00
Brigadier Generals
7,200.00
5,400.00
6,000.00
Lieutenant Colonels
4,200.00
4,800.00
3,300.00
3,600.00
2,700.00
3,000.00
First lieutenants
2,220.00
2,400.00
Second lieutenants
1,920.00
2,040.00
Third lieutenants
1,800.00
The rate of the salary that shall be received by each individual officer shall be fixed in a plantilla of officers of
the Philippine Army to be prepared and approved as required in subparagraph (4), General Provisions, of
section seven of Commonwealth Act Numbered Two hundred and forty-six.
Done at the City of Manila, this seventh day of February, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
thirty-eight, and of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the third.
(Sgd.) MANUEL L. QUEZON
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(Sgd.) JORGE B. VARGAS
Secretary to the President
